description: Redesign Results, Document, and Connect pages with new UI. Results: better card design, add tabs for Schemes vs Insurance, filters, keep all API calls and event logging. Document: cleaner upload UI, better risk highlighting. Connect: dedicated /connect and /ivr pages with environment-variable-driven contact info.
steps: Update c:\Users\angel\Desktop\ArthSathiFinal\frontend\app\results\page.tsx: use Card component for scheme/insurance cards. Improve card design: larger icons, clearer score badges using new color palette (green for high score 70+, amber for medium 40-69, gray for low <40), benefit amount in larger font, 'Why this fits you' (explain_text) in colored info box with ✅ icon, tags as rounded pills with primary/10 background, collapsible details section with score breakdown chart using primary color, Apply/Details/Dismiss buttons using Button component from FEAT-001. Add filter UI: tabs for 'Schemes (N)' and 'Insurance (N)' with icons 🌾 and 🛡️, sticky tab bar. Preserve ALL existing logic: checkConnectivity with HTTP ping (not navigator.onLine), cache in localStorage as as_results_v2, offline banner, API calls to POST /api/schemes/recommend and POST /api/insurance/recommend, event logging to POST /api/schemes/event, empty state with retry. Use new color palette throughout.

Update c:\Users\angel\Desktop\ArthSathiFinal\frontend\app\document\page.tsx: use Card and Button components. Redesign upload section: side-by-side 'Take Photo' 📷 and 'Upload from Gallery' 📁 buttons using Button component with large size, 'Tips for Best Results' card. Redesign results section: risk level badge with better styling using new accent color for warnings, summary card with Card component, risk flags as colored alert boxes (red for high/critical using new palette, amber for medium, green for low), Q&A history as chat-style bubbles (user messages in secondary/10 background, assistant in gray/50). Preserve ALL existing logic: file upload to POST /api/documents/upload, polling GET /api/documents/:id, Q&A to POST /api/documents/:id/question, OCR confidence display, LLM model indicator, localStorage lang detection. Use new color palette, improve mobile layout.

Update c:\Users\angel\Desktop\ArthSathiFinal\frontend\app\channels\page.tsx: rename to c:\Users\angel\Desktop\ArthSathiFinal\frontend\app\connect\page.tsx (change URL from /channels to /connect for consistency). Use Card component for each channel (IVR, WhatsApp, Telegram). Each card shows: large icon, title, contact info (phone/username) from environment variables (NEXT_PUBLIC_IVR_NUMBER, NEXT_PUBLIC_WHATSAPP_NUMBER, NEXT_PUBLIC_TELEGRAM_USERNAME with fallbacks to current hardcoded values), description, 'How to use' expandable section, action Button (Copy Number for IVR, Open WhatsApp/Telegram for others). Use new color palette. Add clear note that these are the official ArthSathi contact channels.

Show large phone icon 📞, IVR number from process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_IVR_NUMBER (default: 02248963501) as huge tap-to-call link (<a href='tel:...' className='text-5xl font-bold text-primary'>), 'How the IVR works' section with step-by-step instructions (1. Call number, 2. Choose language 1-6, 3. Answer questions via keypad, 4. Hear recommendations), 'Supported Languages' list (Hindi, Marathi, Tamil, Telugu, Bengali, English), 'Available 24/7 • Free from most numbers' badge. Use Card and Button components, new color palette.
Update navigation links: ensure Navbar component links to /connect and /ivr, dashboard action cards link correctly, homepage footer links work. Update any hardcoded '/channels' paths to '/connect'.
